title: Grateful Dead Live at Seattle Center Arena on 1973-06-26
lineage: AUDMC > Reel > Reel > DAT > WAV > SHN
source: Audience Recording: FOB, Sony EMC mics spread out across the row > TC-152 master cassette > Amick's Reel recorded at 7-1/2ips > Reel(w/ Dolby)

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced tape captures a representative 1973 jam with an outstanding “The Other One,” though the mix suffers from splices and uneven levels.
ai_review.review: The performances are praised for their adventurous, intertwining solos that epitomize the 1973 Dead sound, with many listeners highlighting a monster rendition of The Other One.  The recording is an audience (AUD) capture – generally warm and “exactly what a ’73 show should sound like,” but several reviewers note splices and unbalanced levels that make parts of the tape sound rough.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strong 4‑star reviews praise the musical interplay and a standout The Other One, while one 2‑star review points out noticeable splice and level issues; overall the show is solid but the recording quality is uneven.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Splices on a couple of songs, occasional level imbalance, but generally captures the live ambience and 1973 vibe well; no major drop‑outs reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Represents a typical early‑summer ’73 set with tight ensemble playing; slightly shorter than usual but maintains strong momentum throughout.
